inputClasses: stub-template project objects (hair, spring, material, expression, ...)
invariants: returns the typed object, its provenance (source template/preset) and its writable pointers

a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
scope.units: revisions are nonnegative integers; timeoutSeconds seconds; maxMemoryMb megabytes; control values in their descriptor units (metres, degrees, normalized)

mutants.description: testGetReturnsTypedObjectProvenanceAndWritablePointers: an unknown id must be objectNotFound; read-only pointers must not appear as writable.
testSetCannotTouchIdsHistoryCredentialsOrDerivedFields: every pointer get reports as non-writable must be refused by set with the revision unchanged.
ProjectStoreTests.testWritablePointersAreEnforced: the store must enforce the writable-pointer policy that get reports.

A report envelope claiming every ObjectPackTests test passed (executed 7, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Project/ObjectPackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: object get is a read over one typed project object and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.
